name: Multi-Scale Entropy for View Quality
definition: A metric to measure the amount of visual information in a rendered volume image by analyzing the Shannon entropy of wavelet coefficients across multiple resolution levels, overcoming the insensitivity of standard histogram-based entropy to pixel correlation.
summary: Multi-Scale Entropy for View Quality is a reference-free metric that quantifies visual information in volume rendering by computing wavelet entropy across scales, capturing structural details and pixel correlations that standard histogram-based methods ignore.
